records.name: Abadia
records.location: Domaine d'Abbadia coastal nature park and protected corniche cliffs between Hendaye and Urrugne, Pyrénées-Atlantiques; source's abbreviation 'Abadia' does not identify exact coastal subarea
records.description: The source's vague 'Abadia' natural-area label most plausibly refers to Hendaye's Domaine d'Abbadia and its coastal footpaths, distinct from the ticketed Château-Observatoire d'Abbadia. The municipal site describes a publicly accessible Conservatoire du littoral landscape with grasslands, woods and a coastal trail; it explicitly prohibits access to the bases of unstable cliffs between Pointe Sainte-Anne and Baie de Loya. Tourism authorities describe seasonal mounted enforcement of natural-site rules. Neither these official sources nor archived cross-source alignment show a dated male cruising encounter, so publication and exact map pin remain on hold.

records.name: A5 Ausfahrt Efringen-Kirchen
records.location: GAYS-CRUISING ARCHIVE CITY/Country appears WRONG. Actual matching gay-szene site: carpark/woodland by Autobahn A5 Efringen-Kirchen exit near Rheinaueweg, Kleinkems, Efringen-Kirchen, Baden-Württemberg, GERMANY, directly across Rhine from French Kembs
records.description: Critical geographic correction. Original French national index assigned an 'A5 Ausfahrt Efringen-Kirchen' spot to Kembs in France, but Germany's A5 exit and gay-szene.net's exact-place entry locate it in Kleinkems (Efringen-Kirchen) on the German bank. This is a newly discovered independent match missed by precomputed eight-source alignment. The gay-szene page describes wooded paths and male naturist/cruising interest; a first-person post dated 25 June 2026 praises the diversity of men at the location, providing credible firsthand evidence of an active gay male meeting scene within twelve months, though not an explicit sex encounter. Another user dated 1 July 2025 complained the parking was blocked by construction fencing, so current legal access to every car park/tree path cannot be inferred from the later review.

records.name: Lac Mort
records.location: Lac Mort (hydroelectric impoundment), 38220 Laffrey, Isère, France, distinct from Lac de Laffrey/Grand Lac beach
records.description: An artificial hydropower lake in Matheysine, correctly identified by local tourism authorities and a walking route updated September 2026. The original Gays-Cruising index marks it as a possible cruising natural area, but no independent current first-person sex/cruising reports were confirmed. The official tourism office strictly prohibits swimming in Lac Mort and prohibits fishing near the north dam and water-intake structures. This is NOT the nearby Lac de Laffrey swimming beach, which has officially monitored bathing water and public beach toilets; mixing the two would create seriously wrong access advice.
